with_dax.speaker: dax
with_dax.text: Vault Orun. The door. Forty people behind it and air for a year, since the seal. If I open it they come out into this. If I do not, they get a year. I never told you which I wanted.

choices.text: Open it. They get to choose too.
Keep it sealed. A year is a year.
Sell the vault's position to the Ashfound. They need a fort.

open.speaker: dax
open.text: They came out. My mother asked who you were. I said the one who opened the door. She said that was not an answer. It is the only one I have.

alone.speaker: player
alone.text: Vault Orun's door, sealed and holding. Forty people and a year of air on the other side.

dead.speaker: player
dead.text: Vault Orun's door. Dax never said which he wanted. You open it, because he would have wanted them to choose.
